_note: Week of October 26–November 1, 2026. Keto week 2: 20 g NET carbs per day for each of you, so every 'carbs' value in this file is net carbs (total carbs minus fiber) and the carbs goal is 20. A total-carb ceiling of 30 g per day also applies this week and steps down every two weeks toward 20 g total. One fish night (Friday) and one steak night (Wednesday). No vegetarian day and no breakfast-for-dinner. Jake eats breakfast with Laine on Saturday and Sunday (see the Weekend tab). Shakes use almond milk. Laine's weekday lunches are two cold jars: pork slaw Mon–Wed, taco salad Thu–Fri (the second is the laineLunch2 field). No lemon or garlic flavoring, no paneer, no raw onion, mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, or farro. Weekly store run targeted at about $164 (see the plan PDF).

tzatziki.name: Special Sauce (Mayo-Dijon-Pickle)
tzatziki.note: This week's sauce card. Used on Tuesday's BLT wraps, Saturday's burger bowls, and the Sunday and Saturday salads (as the Dijon-mayo dressing). Per-meal amounts are in each recipe. Keeps 5 days.
tzatziki.macrosNote: Per 1 tbsp serving (batch makes about 5 tbsp).

ingredients.item: Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — 3 tbsp
Dijon mustard — 1 tbsp
Dill pickles — 20 g
Smoked paprika — ¼ tsp
Water — 1 tbsp, to loosen

steps: Chop the pickle very fine.
Stir the mayo, Dijon, pickle, smoked paprika, and water together until smooth.
Chill 10 min before using.

dinners.name: Chili-Rubbed Pork Tenderloin + Roasted Cabbage & Zucchini
dinners.note: Cook all 650 g of tenderloin tonight (400 g tonight, 250 g set aside for Tuesday's wraps). Laine's Mon–Wed jars use the separate pork roasted Sunday.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 250 g, Laine 150 g
Chili powder — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ½ tsp
Cumin — Jake ¼ tsp, Laine ¼ tsp
Olive oil — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 ¾ tsp
Green cabbage, shredded — Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Zucchini — Jake 80 g, Laine 80 g
Cheddar cheese — Jake 20 g, Laine 15 g
Butter — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 tsp

steps: Rub the tenderloin with the chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Sear in half the olive oil, 2 min per side.
Roast at 425°F for 15–18 min until 145°F inside. Rest 5 min. Cook all 650 g tonight; slice Tuesday's 250 g, cool, and refrigerate.
Toss the cabbage wedges and zucchini with the remaining olive oil and salt. Roast on a second pan 20 min until browned at the edges; add the cheddar for the last 3 min.
Slice the pork and melt the butter over it. Jake gets the bigger portion.

dinners.name: BLT Pork Lettuce Wraps — Leftover + Treat
dinners.note: Leftover Monday pork plus bacon as the treat protein. Cook the bacon fresh; pork can be eaten cold or warmed 30 seconds.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 150 g, Laine 100 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 40 g, Laine 25 g
Romaine lettuce — Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Tomato — Jake 40 g, Laine 35 g
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 1 ½ tbsp, Laine 2 ½ tsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1 tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Cheddar cheese — Jake 30 g, Laine 20 g
English cucumber — Jake 30 g, Laine 50 g
Dill pickles — Jake 20 g, Laine 20 g

steps: Cook the bacon until crisp and drain. Slice Monday's pork thin.
Mix the mayo and Dijon into a quick sauce (see the Special Sauce card on the Snacks tab).
Fill the romaine leaves with pork, bacon, sliced tomato, and cheddar. Spoon the sauce over each.
Serve with the cucumber slices and pickle on the side.

dinners.name: Seared Chuck Tender Steak + Herb Butter, Zucchini & Cauliflower Mash
dinners.note: Cook all 680 g of steak tonight. Jake 250 g and Laine 170 g are eaten tonight; the other 260 g raw is chilled for Sunday's cold steak salad.

ingredients.item: Chuck tender steak — Jake 250 g, Laine 170 g
Butter — Jake 1 ¾ tbsp, Laine 1 ¼ tbsp
Zucchini — Jake 100 g, Laine 80 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¾ tsp, Laine 1 ¼ tsp
Cauliflower — Jake 90 g, Laine 70 g
Heavy cream — Jake 1 ¾ tbsp, Laine 1 ¼ tbsp
Fresh parsley — Jake 3 g, Laine 3 g

steps: Pat the steak dry and season with salt and pepper. Mash the butter with the chopped parsley for the herb butter.
Sear the steak in a very hot pan 3–4 min per side to medium. Rest 8 min, then slice against the grain. Chill Sunday's portion right away.
Steam the cauliflower 8–10 min until very soft. Mash or blend with the cream, a little butter, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Saute the zucchini in the olive oil 4–5 min until just golden. Top the steak with the herb butter and serve with the mash.

dinners.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl — Ground Pork, Cabbage & Zucchini
dinners.note: Cook 340 g of pork tonight (all of it is used tonight; the ground beef jars Thu/Fri use beef cooked Wednesday night).

ingredients.item: Ground pork — Jake 230 g, Laine 110 g
Green cabbage, shredded — Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Zucchini — Jake 50 g, Laine 50 g
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 10 g, Laine 8 g
Fresh ginger — Jake 5 g, Laine 4 g
Soy sauce — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 2 tsp
Sesame oil — Jake 1 ¾ tsp, Laine 1 ¼ tsp
Rice vinegar — Jake 1 tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Sesame seeds — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Eggs — Jake 1 egg, Laine 1 egg

steps: Brown the ground pork in a wide skillet with the onion and ginger, breaking it up, 6–8 min.
Add the cabbage and zucchini and cook 4–5 min until just tender.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Cook 1 min.
Fry the eggs. Plate the bowls with the pork mix, top with the fried egg and sesame seeds.

dinners.name: Pan-Seared Salmon, Soy-Ginger Butter, Sesame Cucumber Salad + Cauliflower Mash
dinners.note: The one fish night this week. Cauliflower mash again, same method as Wednesday.

ingredients.item: Salmon fillet — Jake 190 g, Laine 150 g
Soy sauce — Jake 1 ½ tsp, Laine 1 ½ tsp
Fresh ginger — Jake 3 g, Laine 3 g
Butter — Jake 1 ¾ tbsp, Laine 1 ¼ tbsp
English cucumber — Jake 50 g, Laine 40 g
Rice vinegar — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1 ½ tsp
Sesame oil — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Sesame seeds — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Cauliflower — Jake 60 g, Laine 70 g
Heavy cream — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp

steps: Steam the cauliflower 8–10 min. Mash with the cream and 1 tsp of the butter, salt and pepper.
Slice the cucumber and toss with the rice vinegar, sesame oil, and half the sesame seeds.
Sear the salmon in a hot pan skin-side down 4 min, flip, 3 min more.
Melt the remaining butter with the soy sauce and grated ginger for 30 seconds and spoon over the salmon. Finish with the remaining sesame seeds.

dinners.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Bowls
dinners.note: No bun. Jake gets the bacon on his bowl; Laine's bowl skips it.

ingredients.item: Ground beef 85/15 — Jake 180 g, Laine 170 g
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 15 g, Laine 10 g
Smoked paprika — Jake ¼ tsp, Laine ¼ tsp
Romaine lettuce — Jake 60 g, Laine 50 g
Cheddar cheese — Jake 30 g, Laine 25 g
Dill pickles — Jake 30 g, Laine 25 g
Tomato — Jake 30 g, Laine 30 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 15 g
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 2 ¼ tsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1 tsp, Laine 1 tsp

steps: Brown the ground beef with the onion and smoked paprika, breaking it up. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix the mayo and Dijon for the sauce (Special Sauce card on the Snacks tab).
Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.
Build the bowls: romaine, beef, cheddar, pickle, tomato. Spoon the sauce over and add the bacon for Jake.

dinners.name: Bacon-Cheddar Baked Chicken Thighs + Buttered Zucchini
dinners.note: Chicken is cooked fresh tonight; Jake's lunch batch is the same chicken pack.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 230 g, Laine 150 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 25 g, Laine 20 g
Cheddar cheese — Jake 40 g, Laine 30 g
Smoked paprika — Jake ¼ tsp, Laine ¼ tsp
Zucchini — Jake 100 g, Laine 120 g
Butter — Jake 2 ½ tsp, Laine 2 ¼ tsp

steps: Pat the thighs dry, season with salt, pepper, and smoked paprika. Bake at 425°F for 20 min.
Top with the cheddar and bacon and bake 5 min more until the cheese melts and the thighs reach 175°F.
Saute the zucchini in the butter 4–5 min until just tender.
Serve the thighs with the zucchini. Jake gets the bigger portion.

jakeLunch.name: Coconut-Curry Chicken Thighs + Broccoli Cauli-Rice
jakeLunch.note: Keto batch bowl, same 5-container Sunday format. Chicken thighs simmered in a mild coconut-curry sauce so they stay moist through 5 days of reheating. Broccoli and cauliflower rice stand in for quinoa. No spinach, no fish, no lemon, no garlic. Cauliflower rice is raw-weight; steam it in the container when reheating.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — 1150 g total (230 g per container)
Coconut milk, full-fat — 250 g total (50 g per container)
Curry powder — 5 tsp total (1 tsp per container)
Fresh ginger — 15 g total (3 g per container)
Yellow onion (cooked in) — 25 g total (5 g per container)
Butter — 5 tbsp total (1 tbsp per container)
Olive oil — 4 ¼ tbsp total (2 ½ tsp per container)
Broccoli florets — 300 g total (60 g per container)
Cauliflower — 300 g total (60 g per container)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season with salt and pepper. Sear in the butter and olive oil in batches, 4–5 min per side, until browned. Remove.
In the same pan, cook the onion and ginger 2–3 min until soft. Stir in the curry powder for 30 seconds, then the coconut milk and a splash of water. Simmer 3–4 min.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer 8–10 min until cooked through (175°F for thighs). Slice or leave whole.
Steam the broccoli 4–5 min until just tender (it keeps cooking when reheated). Rice the cauliflower raw or pulse in a processor.

Divide into 5 containers: cauliflower rice and broccoli on one side, chicken with plenty of sauce on the other. Reheat with a splash of water. Cook an extra 120 g of thigh for Saturday's salad and the Sunday dinner thighs fresh.

laineLunch.name: Sesame-Ginger Pork Slaw Jar (Mon–Wed)
laineLunch.note: Cold, crunchy, grab-and-go. Sliced cold pork over a sesame-soy dressing with crisp cabbage and cucumber. No fish, no egg, no reheating. Made for 3 jars: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — 180 g per jar (540 g for 3)
Green cabbage, shredded — 40 g per jar (120 g for 3)
English cucumber — 60 g per jar (180 g for 3)
Soy sauce — 1 ½ tsp per jar (1 ½ tbsp for 3)
Sesame oil — 2 ¼ tsp per jar (2 ¼ tbsp for 3)
Rice vinegar — 1 ½ tsp per jar (1 ½ tbsp for 3)
Fresh ginger — 2 g per jar (6 g for 3)
Sesame seeds — 1 tsp per jar (1 tbsp for 3)
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — 1 ¾ tbsp per jar (5 ¼ tbsp for 3)

steps: Sunday: roast 540 g of extra pork tenderloin (salt and pepper, 425°F, 15–18 min to 145°F). Chill, then slice thin.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, and mayo for the dressing.
Layer each jar: dressing and pork slices on the bottom, then cabbage and cucumber on top so they stay crisp. Sprinkle the sesame seeds on top.
Keep cold. Shake or tip into a bowl to eat. Two sittings per jar if you like.

laineLunch2.name: Cold Taco Salad Jar (Thu–Fri)
laineLunch2.note: Cold and crunchy, with mild seasoned beef. Romaine, cheddar, cucumber, and tomato layered over the beef. No reheating. Made for 2 jars: Thursday and Friday.

ingredients.item: Ground beef 85/15 — 160 g per jar (320 g for 2)
Yellow onion (cooked in) — 8 g per jar (16 g for 2)
Chili powder — ¼ tsp per jar (½ tsp for 2)
Cumin — ¼ tsp per jar (½ tsp for 2)

steps: Wednesday night: brown 320 g ground beef 85/15 with the onion, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika. Cool and refrigerate.
Layer each jar: mayo and beef on the bottom, then cheddar, tomato, cucumber, and romaine on top.
Keep cold. Shake or tip into a bowl to eat.

laineBreakfasts.name: Cheddar Egg Scramble

Add the remaining butter and the beaten eggs; scramble gently. Fold in the cheddar off the heat and serve.

weekendMeals.name: Cheddar Egg Scramble

Butter — Jake 1 ¼ tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Cook the onion in half the butter over medium-low until soft, 2–3 min.
Add the remaining butter and the beaten eggs; scramble gently. Fold in the cheddar off the heat and serve.

weekendMeals.name: Chef Salad with Dijon-Mayo Dressing
weekendMeals.note: Made fresh, nothing batched. Jake adds cold chicken thigh from the Sunday batch; Laine's has no chicken.

ingredients.item: Romaine lettuce — Jake 70 g, Laine 60 g
Eggs — Jake 2 eggs, Laine 2 eggs
Cheddar cheese — Jake 30 g, Laine 20 g
Tomato — Jake 40 g, Laine 40 g

Dijon mustard — Jake 1 tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 120 g
English cucumber — Jake 40 g, Laine 50 g

Build the salads: romaine, cucumber, tomato, egg, cheddar. Add Jake's sliced cold chicken thigh. Drizzle with the dressing.

weekendMeals.name: Almond-Flour Waffles with Oikos
weekendMeals.note: Jake eats with Laine. Fried eggs and bacon on the side for Jake.

Brush the waffle iron with butter and cook the batter until set and golden, 4–5 min.
Fry Jake's extra eggs and cook his bacon. Top the waffles with the Oikos.
